entries.reachability_signal: The probe calls Element.itertext() on elements containing Comment and PI children, hitting elementiter_next with gettext=1. The guard condition at line 2300 is tested.
entries.expected_signal: BEFORE: itertext() returns text for Comment/PI elements. AFTER: itertext() skips Comment/PI elements, returning empty strings for them and only emitting regular element text.
entries.input_strategy: Python probe constructing Element tree with Comment('comment') and ProcessingInstruction('test', 'instruction') children, then calling ''.join(e.itertext()) and comment.itertext() / pi.itertext()
entries.limitations: Requires GCC and CPython build dependencies (configure --without-ensurepip). Gcov requires -O0 -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage. Only tests the C implementation (not the Python fallback).
